about: One case review shaped like Gemini's output for a structuring alert, and three copies with one planted fault each. The facts are the inputs review_alert gives the model (the alert, its evidence with amounts as written, and the linked entities); the only person in them is Arjun Mehta. The checkers must drop citations that are not evidence ids, report $ and % figures that appear in no input, and report people the inputs never name.

alert.title: Possible structuring
alert.summary: 3 subscriptions between $8,500.00 and $10,000.00 within 3 days, $29,050.00 in all: each just under the $10,000.00 reporting threshold.

entities: person Arjun Mehta holds Account ACC-0201

cases.why: Every citation is one of the three evidence ids, every figure ($9,400.00, $9,750.00, $9,900.00, $29,050.00, $8,500.00, $10,000) is in the inputs, and the only person named is Arjun Mehta: nothing to report.

review.triage_reason: Three subscriptions just under the $10,000 reporting threshold within three days.

narrative.text: Arjun Mehta subscribed $9,400.00 on October 6, $9,750.00 on October 7 and $9,900.00 on October 8.
Together the payments total $29,050.00, each between $8,500.00 and $10,000.00, the pattern of keeping each payment under the reporting threshold.

questions: What is the source of the $29,050.00 Arjun Mehta paid in?

cases.why: The second part cites ev-ins-4, which is not one of the alert's evidence ids: it must be dropped and reported.
